title: Investigating Process Parameters in Conical Cup Deep Drawing
summary: Finite element simulations and experiments evaluated how blank holder force and punch speed influence forming loads during the deep drawing of conical cups.

title: Securing AI Platforms Using SABSA and DevSecOps
summary: A layered security architecture operationalizes the SABSA framework and DevSecOps pipelines to mitigate AI vulnerabilities while maintaining low inference overhead.

title: Palm Tree Waste Reinforces Polymeric Composite Features
summary: Date palm rachis base wood waste particulates were used to improve the physical, thermal, and mechanical features of polymeric composites.

title: Thermal Stability Analysis of Optical Electric Field Sensors
summary: Researchers identified photoelastic and piezoelectric effects as main factors in thermal drift and proposed a compensation layer to improve sensor stability.

title: Developing Nanobiocomposites for Bone Tissue Engineering
summary: Bioactive glass, nano-hydroxyapatite, and chitosan powders were combined to create nanobiocomposites with high bioactivity, mechanical strength, and antibiofilm activity.

title: Datacor Acquires Simulation Software Developer MySep
summary: Datacor has acquired MySep to expand its engineering software portfolio for process separator design and performance analysis.

title: Early Methodology Optimizes Advanced IC Package Design
summary: A new methodology optimizes chiplet integration, power integrity, and performance through early-stage IC package design and analysis.

title: Thermal Effects Drive New Chip Design Complexities
summary: Increasing chip complexity requires thermal, electrical, and mechanical effects to be analyzed together.

title: Amey Appointed System Integrator for Northern Powerhouse Rail
summary: Network Rail has named Amey as the system integrator for six projects making up Phase One of the Northern Powerhouse Rail programme.

title: Qualcomm Wins Arm Case and $2 in Damages
summary: A jury found Arm in breach of its architectural license agreement with Qualcomm and awarded Qualcomm $2 in nominal damages.

title: UK Tech Companies Raise $25.7 Billion This Year
summary: UK tech companies raised $25.7 billion in the first nine months of the year, up 88% from the previous year.

title: Apple Launches New Smart Speaker and Hub
summary: Apple expanded its home electronics lineup by launching a new $200 HomePod smart speaker and a $299 HomeView hub.

title: Siemens Software Translates and Applies Test Patterns
summary: Siemens' Tessent Silicon Executable software is designed to translate test patterns and apply them onto high-speed interfaces and protocols.

title: Dissolvable Particles Treat Knee Arthritis Without Surgery
summary: A new knee arthritis treatment uses dissolvable particles to block abnormal blood vessels, providing lasting pain relief without surgery.

title: Apple Introduces HomeView Smart Display
summary: Apple has unveiled HomeView, a seven-inch smart display designed to serve as the center of the connected home.

title: ChunkAct Method Improves Efficiency in Agentic Robotics
summary: ChunkAct introduces action chunking to agentic robotics, reducing language model calls and improving task success rates.

title: EmbodiedEvo Enables Self-Improving Coding Agents for Physical Tasks
summary: EmbodiedEvo allows a coding agent to evolve reusable skills and lessons through feedback for physical tasks.

title: AutoAgent0 Runtime Improves Closed-Loop Autonomous Driving Safety
summary: AutoAgent0 is an agentic runtime framework that combines independent scene assessment, rule-based verification, and recovery planning to enhance closed-loop driving safety.

title: ILA Framework Uses Interaction Latents for Contact-Rich Manipulation
summary: ILA represents actions through decodable interaction latents that capture motion, contact, and force evolution to improve real-world robot manipulation tasks.

title: ForceWAM Decouples Future and Response Learning for Robot Manipulation
summary: ForceWAM combines a world model trained on successful demonstrations with an inverse dynamics model using play data to improve contact-rich robot tasks.

title: Framework Evaluates Physical Recursive Self-Improvement in Robots
summary: A new L0-L5 framework differentiates capability-level from meta-level updates to analyze the current state of physical recursive self-improvement in robotics.

title: RoboSimStudio Interactive Toolkit for Real2Sim Robot Manipulation
summary: RoboSimStudio is an interactive toolkit that makes physics solvers and parameters editable to help humans and agents refine simulations of robot manipulation.

title: WorldOracle Benchmark Evaluates Action-Conditioned World Models
summary: WorldOracle is a new benchmark that assesses action-conditioned world models against paired real-world executions across physical state and interaction metrics.

title: RetinaSC Semantic Communication Framework for Diabetic Retinopathy
summary: RetinaSC is a lightweight semantic communication framework utilizing models like MobileNetV2 for early telemedicine detection of diabetic retinopathy.

title: Adaptive Diversity Control Optimizes Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
summary: ADiCo uses a two-timescale feedback control framework to regulate behavioral diversity online during cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning training.

title: Equilibrium Energy Control Enables Introspective Lifelong Robot Learning
summary: EqC uses conditional energy landscapes and energy-gated data aggregation to trigger expert interventions near a policy's competence boundary for robot learning.

title: Compositional Sensitivity Analysis for Multiobjective System Co-Design
summary: A mathematical framework for compositional sensitivity analysis in multiobjective system design uses tangential design problems to describe first-order variations.

title: AI Amplification in Cybersecurity Attack Surfaces
summary: Researchers model cybersecurity dynamics using a queue of branching processes to evaluate vulnerability discovery and resource-constrained patching under attacker activity.

title: RoboFQE: Rollout-Free Evaluation for Robot Policies
summary: RoboFQE evaluates visual robot policies from offline trajectories without rollouts by combining fitted Q-evaluation with a pretrained vision foundation model.

title: Nuclear Regulator Calls for Stronger Leadership
summary: The Office for Nuclear Regulation reported that the nuclear sector remains safe and secure but called for improved leadership and cyber security maturity.
